name: Happy_3
short_caption: The robot enthusiastically raises its right arm high in a victorious celebration of happiness.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture, then raises its right arm high into the air with a closed fist while tilting its head up and to the left in a cheerful gesture. It holds this triumphant, happy pose for a moment with its head slightly cocked. Finally, it smoothly lowers its right arm and returns its head to center, settling back into its neutral rest position.
safety_notes: The right arm extends fully upward and slightly outward; ensure sufficient overhead and side clearance so the robot does not strike low-hanging objects or nearby visitors.
